# Interface How-To — Discovery phase

<!-- GENERATED by src/tests/exploration/gen-howto.ts — do not edit by hand.
     Requests derive from the tested exploration bindings; responses + MCP
     schemas from .out/howto-capture.json; option tables from @Option /
     inputSchema / @ApiProperty. howto-conformance.spec.ts fails CI on drift. -->

Frame the initiative and check the discovery gate before committing to a design.

**Envelope:** every response is an ADR-0073 envelope `{ success, data | error: { code, message }, meta }`.
**Exit codes (CLI):** `0` on a passing verdict, non-zero on a failing verdict or error.
**Mutative MCP tools** require `{ "apply": true, "approvalToken": "…" }` (the dispatch gates them; `RULESET_NOT_FOUND` etc. are consistent across surfaces).

Operations in this phase: `gate-evaluate`, `sdlc-status`, `moscow-report`, `topology-list`, `phase-requirements`.

---
### Phase gate evaluation

> `gate-evaluate` — Evaluate a specific SDLC phase gate (discovery/design/construction/qa/release) and emit GateEvidence

#### CLI
Command: `evolith-cli gate evaluate`

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-p, --phase <phase>` | SDLC phase: discovery, design, construction, qa, release |
| `-s, --satellite [path]` | Satellite project path (default: nearest-ancestor evolith.yaml from cwd) |
| `--project [path]` | [deprecated] Alias for --satellite (ADR-0109) |
| `-c, --core [path]` | Evolith Core path (default: auto-detect) |
| `-f, --format [string]` | Output format: json (ADR-0073 envelope) or human (default) |
| `--evaluated-by [actor]` | Actor class: human (default), agent, ci |
| `--initiative [id]` | Opaque initiative context, echoed in meta.context |
| `--tenant [id]` | Opaque tenant context, echoed in meta.context |
| `--webhook-url <url>` | URL to POST the gate evidence upon completion |

Example:
```bash
evolith-cli gate evaluate --phase discovery --project /abs/path/to/your-satellite --core /abs/path/to/evolith-core --evaluated-by ci --format json
```
Response (captured live):

### SDLC phase status

> `sdlc-status` — Get current SDLC phase status showing which artifacts are present per phase

#### CLI
Command: `evolith-cli sdlc gate-status`

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--since <days>` | Days of git history to analyse for DORA metrics (default: 90) |
| `-f, --format <string>` | Output format: json (ADR-0073 envelope) or human (default) |
| `-c, --core [path]` | Path to the Evolith Core checkout that holds the canonical SDLC gates (default: auto-detect) |

Example:
```bash
evolith-cli sdlc gate-status --core /abs/path/to/evolith-core --format json
```

### Generate MoSCoW report

> `moscow-report` — Generate a markdown report of a MoSCoW analysis

#### CLI
_Not on CLI — low priority; CLI users can generate manually._

#### MCP
Tool: `evolith-moscow-report`

| Argument | Type | Req. | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | ✓ | — |
| `phase` | string | ✓ | — |

Example (`tools/call`):
```json
{
  "name": "evolith-moscow-report",
  "arguments": {
    "phase": "design"
  }
}
```
Response (captured live):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "error": true,
    "message": "path is required"
  },
  "meta": {
    "correlationId": "<uuid>",
    "command": "evolith-moscow-report",
    "tool": "evolith-moscow-report",
    "durationMs": 0,
    "executedAt": "<timestamp>",
    "timestamp": "<timestamp>",
    "context": {
      "phase": "design"
    },
    "schemaVersion": "1.0.0"
  }
}
```

#### REST
_Not on REST — low priority; not requested by any consumer._

### List architecture topologies

> `topology-list` — List all available architecture topologies from the Evolith catalog

#### CLI
_Not on CLI — available via `evolith api` browser; low-value as standalone CLI command._

#### MCP
Tool: `evolith-topology-list`

| Argument | Type | Req. | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `corePath` | string |  | Optional explicit path to the Evolith core repository |

Example (`tools/call`):
```json
{
  "name": "evolith-topology-list",
  "arguments": {}
}
```

### Get phase requirements

> `phase-requirements` — Fetch the evidence and blocking requirements for an SDLC phase

#### CLI
_Not on CLI — available via `evolith api --inspect`; low-value as standalone CLI command._

#### MCP
_Not on MCP — requirements metadata is embedded in evolith-gate-evaluate response._

#### REST
Endpoint: `GET /api/v1/phases/:phase/requirements`

Example:
```http
GET /api/v1/phases/design/requirements
Content-Type: application/json

{}
```
Response (captured live):
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
```
